messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell any doctor treating you that you are using buspirone"
set: ["tell any doctor treating you that you are using buspirone", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using empagliflozin", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine", "tell any doctor or dentist treating you that you take spironolactone", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are taking apixaban", "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol", "tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication", "tell your doctor if you have any side effect that bothers you or that does not go away", "tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding a baby", "tell your doctor if you are of chinese descent", "tell your doctor about all current medicines and any you start or stop using", "tell doctor if you develop breathlessness", "any healthcare provider should know you are taking it", "tell your doctor if you are sick with vomiting or diarrhea", "tell your doctor about all your medications and any you start or stop using during treatment", "tell your doctor if you also use"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
